title: L115 — THE SIGNAL EVERYONE SAW
voice: You checked your chart, and every single indicator was pointing the same direction, so you placed the trade without a second thought.
The problem is not that the signals were wrong, because they were reading the same data and producing the same answer at the same time.
When every retail trader reads the same confirmation, their stops land at the same level, and that cluster becomes the easiest target on the chart.
The trade that looks the safest is the one that costs the most to fill, because every other buyer already arrived at the same price.
When everyone agrees, you are the liquidity. Follow KONGRAVE — the mechanics nobody explains.
